prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one native transparent full-body character costume master for a hand-painted 2D arcade fighting game. Produce exactly one character, completely inside the image, facing RIGHT in a relaxed ready stance with slightly flexed knees, head and shoes and entire weapon visible, generous transparent padding on every edge. Aim for a square 1024x1024 canvas. Match the crisp hand-painted arcade shading, clean silhouette and compact realistic anatomy of the LAST attached image, Isaac, strictly as STYLE reference; do not copy Isaac's identity, hat, facial hair or clothing. This is a faithful fan-made 2D adaptation of the specific game costume in the subject reference, not an invented outfit or a photograph. Natural neutral lighting. No background, floor, ground shadow, UI, typography, labels, muzzle flash, duplicate person, montage or sprite sheet. Keep genuine transparent alpha.
Subject reference images 1 and 2 show G in The House of the Dead III. Isolate and adapt ONLY the older male agent G; omit Lisa and Death. Preserve G's older angular face and slicked-back dark hair strongly streaked with grey, pale blue long-sleeved shirt, pale grey buttoned waistcoat, yellow/gold narrow necktie, charcoal grey formal trousers and dark simple shoes. The first image gives the face and colors; the second gives his complete body and trouser/shoe silhouette. G is a lean, experienced middle-aged man, not a bodybuilder. Hold the short black pump shotgun visible in those promotional references at a low ready angle to the RIGHT, both hands naturally placed. One clean full-body three-quarter side view, face recognizable as the reference, composed into the square as a readable game sprite. Do not add a coat, hat, shoulder armor or extra holsters.
limitations: Une image statique de galerie. Aucun profil jouable, aucune action ni tenue sélectionnable ajoutés par ce fichier.
Adaptation 2D fan-made ; ressemblance révisée sur références, fidélité1:1 non certifiée.

Le rendu plein pied montre G surtout de dos ; la vue de combat trois-quarts et les plis du gilet sont une adaptation.
